author_notes: Native PC port by static recompilation. Supply your own Motor Toon Grand Prix (USA) disc (SCUS-94355, Redump CUE/BIN). No BIOS dump is needed: the release bundles OpenBIOS (MIT). Boot, menus, Championship races and the Goodies bonus programs are tested on Windows; Linux and macOS packages are built by CI but untested by hand. Two Player Battle is the link-cable mode and is not supported.
description: Cartoon kart racing from Polyphony Digital, recompiled natively for PC.
name: Motor Toon Grand Prix
notes: Prebuilt zips only (no local build block): CI builds the committed generated C. bios_identity is null because the packages ship OpenBIOS; the framework is pinned to Cr1TiKa7/psxrecomp (upstream plus an OpenBIOS SetConf fix). Disc digests are the Redump Track 01 values for Motor Toon Grand Prix (USA).
